answer: Time-locked contribution ledger. Each identity must continuously supply verified compute or data to a shared pool, scored per epoch on a public terrace. New identities stay capped until they accumulate history, so an attacker must run real work for many epochs before gaining weight. The cost is sustained compute and maintenance, not a one-time payment. Honest nodes meet in a stable oasis of reputation; forged identities echo the same cost with no shortcut.
